title: Stupidly easy craftable items
description: This adds recipes to items that were previously uncraftable in minecraft 1.20.1
body:
This mod adds recipes to previously uncraftable items in 1.20.1 with super easy recipes. In fact, it's so easy it's stupid.
Crafting recipes for:
Saddle
Name Tag
Horse Armor (leather, Iron, Gold, Diamond)
Totem of Undying
Enchanted Golden Apple
Chainmail Armor
Cobweb
Bell
Elytra
